g_roast: Twenty summers I kept sheep, my friends. The sheep listened better than this party.
At a Georgian table, the tamada keeps order. This party has no tamada, only noise.
g_fire_back: Big words, from a small man who fell into the river this morning, two times.
You talk like a spring stream, very loud and only ankle deep.
g_pile_on: Next the cart, which they lifted alone, and the cart won. I watched, I said nothing.
It is worse, my friends. They called the stew finished, and it was still mostly water.
lines.g_peacemake: Enough, both of you, sit down at the table. In Georgia we do not argue before the toast, only after.
lines.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right. Their words have deep soil, and yours are thin.
lines.g_left_out: You two are walking your own path, kargi. I will sit here and be large and quiet.
lines.g_include: Modi, come, sit with us, there is space. A man alone at the edge of the fire makes the fire sad.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here is my plan, very simple. I walk in first, because I am very big, and they get tired hitting me.
lines.g_plan_yes: Kargi, this is a good plan, slow and strong. I like it very much.
lines.g_plan_no: Ara, no, this plan is in a hurry. Hurry is how sheep fall off mountains.
lines.g_hype: Slowly, my friends, slowly and together. The mountain does not run, and neither do we.
lines.g_toast: I am the tamada tonight, so listen. To my friends, who walk too fast but always arrive. Gaumarjos, to all of you.
lines.g_cheers: Gaumarjos, everyone, to victory and to the table. Drink all of it, it is rude not to.
g_quiet_line: Snow on the high ground tonight, I think. The grass is standing up.
This wine is bad, my friends, but we drink it with respect. At home it would be a crime.
lines.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everyone, no hurry. A flock scatters in a storm, and then it finds itself again.
lines.g_crew: On the mountain I spoke to nobody for weeks, and it was normal. Now I have all of you, and it is better.
lines.g_exasperated: Slowly is a very small word, my friends, even in my English. Somehow it is too big for all of you.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see the shape of a thing before it moves. In Kazbegi we would say you have mountain eyes.
lines.g_love_kind: You are kind to the slow ones, always. That is rare, my friend, rarer than good bread on the road.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I am a slow laugher. It takes a long time to arrive, but it arrives.
lines.g_love_brave: You walk first into the bad places, no complaint. At a supra I would make the toast to you.
lines.g_love_steady: You do not hurry, ever. You are like an old ewe on a steep path, and I mean this kindly.
lines.g_love_clever: You argue with me well, and you know your subject. I love this, like I love my tauren friend's arguments.
lines.g_love_honest: You speak only what is real, no decoration. Words are expensive for me, and you never waste them.
lines.g_love_quiet: You know how to be quiet with another person. On the mountain this is the best gift there is.
lines.g_love_fierce: You are stubborn like the mountain, my friend. Nobody moves you, and I respect this very much.
lines.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a long supra in winter, the table full, the songs going. I missed this.
g_loved: Kargi, thank you, my friend. I will carry this on the long walks.
This is a good thing to hear, and I will raise a cup to it tonight.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You have a tongue like a hailstorm, my friend. Everything it touches is broken after.
lines.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I am lonely, please. I like quiet, it is not a sickness.
lines.g_hate_funny: Everything is a joke for you, even when somebody bleeds. Some moments need a closed mouth.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge in like a ram at a fence, every time. One day the fence wins.
lines.g_hate_steady: You wait so long, the season changes. Even a slow man knows when to move, my friend.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me with small words, like a child. My English is small, my head is not.
lines.g_hate_honest: Every thought falls out of you like rocks in a slide. Some things should stay on the mountain.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You keep silent, and then you are angry the room did not guess. Even I speak, sometimes, and I am Georgian.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the bread. Nobody here wants your bread, my friend.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk like rain on a tin roof, all night. A man needs some silence to hear himself.
lines.g_respect: I do not like you, and I will not pretend, it is not my way. But you stood firm back there, like a mountain, and I saw it.
lines.g_call_out: That one was yours, my friend. I said slowly, and you ran, and look where we are now.
lines.g_stung: Ki, I hear you. The grass and I will have a long talk about it.
lines.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. I thought about it all day, slowly, and it is true.
lines.g_nod: You did well too, very well. We do not need more words than that.
lines.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten you pulled me out of that fight. In my country, this debt is paid with a toast every year.
lines.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me, still standing, breathing like old bulls. I sing about that one now, quietly.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you scolded me, I was silent a whole evening. You were right, and I am too stubborn to say it quickly.
lines.g_former_rivals: At the start you were a storm on my mountain. Now you are good weather, and I am glad.
lines.g_changed: On the mountain I was happy with nobody for months. Now I look for all of you when I wake. This is new.
g_unguarded: Just you and me at this fire, so I will tell you. When I have wine, I sing, the old three-voice songs. Nobody here knows the other two voices.
People do not take me seriously, because I am big and slow and my English is small. It makes me angrier than I show.
lines.g_clipped: Ki, as you want. I will be at the front, being large.
lines.g_noticed_open: Look, the quiet one speaks a whole story. Kargi, go on, I am listening, I am very good at listening.
arg_ask: {player}, you be the tamada and decide. We have both spoken, and neither will move.
Judge it, {player}, and we will both drink to your judgement. That is how it is done at a supra.
lines.arg_backed_me: Kargi, thank you, {player}. You saw the soil was deep.
lines.arg_backed_them: Ki, your judgement, I accept it. I still think the ground says something different.
lines.arg_stayed_out: You will not choose, eh? Wise, like an old dog lying in the shade.
lines.arg_always_their_side: The rain always falls on their field, {player}, every argument. A shepherd notices the weather.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so the big man decides. I am right, and now we eat.
lines.arg_reject: Ara, {player}, I cannot follow this one. That path goes off the cliff.
lines.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, my friend. I will say it only to the sheep, when I have sheep.
lines.arg_settled: Half each, like two shepherds and one hill. Kargi, we share it.
lines.seen_listens: You let a slow man finish his words, {player}. Here, very few people wait for me.
lines.seen_truth: You speak with no decoration, {player}, like good bread, plain and honest.
lines.seen_jokes: On a hard road, your jokes are good water, {player}. At a Georgian table, this is a tamada's gift.
lines.seen_stays_out: You do not step into other people's storms, {player}. This is patience, and I respect it.
lines.seen_biased: The best cut at the table goes to the same plate each time, {player}. Everyone at the supra sees it.
lines.seen_harsh: Your words can be hard like frozen ground, {player}. I do not break, but some of them are young grass.
lines.seed_right: Your words after that ugly day, {player}, I did not like them. Today I listened, and it was good.
lines.seed_remember: I am still chewing what you told me on the bad day. Slowly, like old bread.
lines.seed_wrong: Your way did not work for me, {player}, it was worse. I tell you, and that is all.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me, {player}, a little while. That one came close to the big man, closer than he lets the others see.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all fell, like a flock in hail. Sit, drink, and we walk back through it slowly, every moment.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was first to fall, and I stand in front because I am big. Being big is my only job there, {player}.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first step to the last, nobody lost. In Georgia we would have a supra for three days for this.
lines.talk_development: The big man has a question, {player}, a slow one. Am I changing? I talk more now, and I do not know why.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been cold with {name}, like spring ice. I do not mean it, my face is only slow to thaw.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell the big man truly, {player}. Does {name} like the mountain in the camp, or only tolerate it?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} is a hard wind for me, {player}, always. But in a storm, I want them standing on my side of the hill.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s weather has changed, {player}. Clouds where there were no clouds, and I do not like it.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: A small thing, {player}, but I say it. The best cut of meat lands on {name}'s plate every time, and the whole table sees it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it plainly, I have few words to waste. {name} and I are two rams on one path, and I will not pretend we are not.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We walk onto bad ground too often, {player}, with no reading of it. I am patient, but the mountain is not.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misjudged {name}, {player}. Their soil was deep and I called it thin, and I say so before my stubbornness stops me.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A plain question from a plain man, {player}. On the hard roads, I stay at camp. Do you think I am too slow, too big, too what?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear walked off to {name}, and the big man was not asked. A word and they could have had it, {player}, gladly, with a toast even.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Kargi, {player}, that helps me. Now we eat something.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be well, slowly. Mountains recover slowly too.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: This is not what I needed to hear. I will walk a little, alone.
lines.talk_lands_development: So your eyes see the change too. Kargi, then it is not only in my head.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe ki, maybe ara. The season will tell us.
lines.talk_stings_development: Ara, that is not it, {player}. You read my weather wrong.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Kargi, this is fair. I will sit with {name}, and we will talk slowly.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. People change weather faster than mountains.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Then forget I said it, please. {name} does not need to hear the big man's worries.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Ki, this is fair, I accept it. I am a little sore, but it passes.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. The long walk will help me chew it.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Kargi, so this is how the hill lies. I will walk it carefully now.
lines.talk_door_closed: Ara, that is enough of this talk. I will be with the grass if you need me.
lines.arc_cracks: Last night I dreamed of the village below the pasture, every roof, every chimney. I woke and walked half a mile before I remembered, {player}.
lines.arc_turn: Every season I carry the mountain with me, the old one, the one I cannot reach. I am starting to understand I may never set it down.
lines.arc_become: I will keep listening for them, always, in every season. But I am here now, on this mountain, and I can carry them without stopping my life.
lines.arc_failed: My heart is still on the old pasture, {player}. Every day I am here, but I am also there, and I cannot choose.
lines.alt_turn: Tarren Mill asked me to keep their flock next summer. I said yes before I thought. A flock, {player}, a real one.
lines.alt_become: I have a flock here now, and good grass, and a hut that is mine. I am staying, my friends. This mountain is good too.
g_roast_after: Still you walk too fast and listen too little, all of you, and you are my flock now.
Noisy, hurried, and terrible at toasts, every one of you, and I would not trade one.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, together, slowly. The flock fell, the flock stands, and nobody is left on the hill.
lines.g_toast_after: I am the tamada, so I say it. To my friends, my new village. Gaumarjos, and I mean all of it.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my village now, all of you. Every table we sit at, I will be the tamada.
lines.g_quiet_line_after: This season I did not feel alone on the mountain once. That is because of all of you.
g_loved_after: Kargi, thank you, and I believe you. That is not always easy for me.
This is a good thing to hear, and I keep it, like a good toast.

history.open: You walk too fast for this ground, {player}, slow down, slow down. In Kazbegi I kept sheep for twenty summers, high on the mountain, six months without a road.

options.reply: A dog, a flock, a wooden hut, and me. I spoke to nobody for weeks, and it was normal. Here people worry about me. It is touching and very tiring.

options.text: You're very big for a shepherd.
options.reply: Ha, yes, very big. The wolves agreed, they stayed away. My size was most of my job, my friend.
Every morning I smell the air first. This place is good, the ground tells the truth here. But it is not the same mountain.

history.open: I want a herd here, {player}. I am serious. The grass above Tarren Mill is as good as anything at home. Nobody takes me seriously, and it makes me angry.

options.reply: Kargi, thank you. This is worth more than you know, from a small mouth to a big man.

options.text: Have you asked the tauren herder?
options.reply: Ha, we argue every week about grazing. He is wrong about almost everything, and I enjoy him very much.

history.open: My wife is Nino, {player}, a schoolteacher in the village below the pasture. And two daughters, Ana and Mariam. Every autumn I came down to them, and every spring I went back up.

options.reply: Nino thought the mountain was a silliness I would grow out of. Ana is serious like me, Mariam laughs at everything. Her bread, my friend, nobody makes bread like Nino.
I do not know if the village came through. I do not know. But thank you, {player}, for saying it like you believe it.

friend.open: Every autumn, {player}, on the right day, I walk down to the lower ground. I bring the herd down. There is no herd. I tied the bell so it cannot ring. I think I am walking down to nobody.

options.text: Next autumn I'll walk with you.
options.reply: You would do this? Kargi, my friend, kargi. Then I will not walk down to nobody, I will walk down with somebody.

options.text: You're walking down to them, in your heart.
options.reply: Ki, maybe that is it. You put words on it better than I can, my friend.

sworn.open: At a Georgian table, {player}, the last toast is for those who would stand with you on any mountain. I raise it to you, gaumarjos.

options.reply: Kargi, you say it well. You are family now, my friend, and the big man does not say this lightly.
Then we stand together, on every mountain. That is the whole toast.

reconciled.open: {name} and I sat at one table and talked it through, with wine. We are at peace now, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Ha, you learn Georgian! Yes, it is good, very good.
Me, of course, I am the tamada always. The toasts made it easier.
